painpoints.text: File-tool edits leave sources with epoch (1970-01-01) mtimes, so cargo/nextest silently ran stale binaries and produced logically impossible failures (pure-function assert passed while the gate using it failed) — cost ~4 diagnostic calls in run 01M2TJ9JZGE42JNBJ22A258MBZ before `stat` revealed it. Fix idea: the stage envelope's file tools should set a real mtime on write, or verify.nu should `touch` diff-listed sources before building (recorded as mx-6376dd).

`bun run generate` in `lib/packages/fabro-api-client` needs a Java runtime the run sandbox does not ship (`java: not found`), blocking the OpenAPI-first TS regen step for every API-schema seed. Fix idea: bake a JRE into the run image or provide a java-less generation path (recorded as mx-7b4b22); this pass hand-mirrored the two-line generator diff as a disclosed fallback.

observations: The lifecycle-table remap is retroactive: replaying historic event streams reclassifies old quota `Failed{soft_stop}` runs as `Blocked{quota_rate_limit}` — consistent by design (one classifier, one table), but anyone diffing stored summaries before/after deploy will see status flips on old quota runs.

The store's terminal-set SQL changed in two places with opposite directions: `list_terminal_for_automation` now INCLUDES concluded blocked runs (breaker must see-and-skip quota parks, or its high-water mark never persists — caught by the breaker exemption pin test), while `active_run_for_automation` EXCLUDES them (else the overlap guard deadlocks the line's scheduled fires after a quota window). The distinguishing invariant is `status='blocked' AND completed_at_ms IS NOT NULL`, which holds exactly because only RunFailed/RunCompleted events set a conclusion.

`just verify implementer` classified crates with inline `#[cfg(test)]` module edits as compile-only (nextest only for fabro-api); the full suites for fabro-types/workflow/server were run manually to compensate — the verify dispatcher may undercount test-touching crates when tests live inline.
